subject: Geography
source: Seeded from geography/y10 lesson 50 (Own 4GE1-style exam questions with indicative mark points (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 50: Case study: managing the Holderness coast at Mappleton (2.3). Answer every question. Show your working. Mark it with the mark scheme and log any errors in your repair list.

questions.q: 'Evaluate the success of coastal management in a named area in a developed country.' Timed: 12 minutes in the portal response box.
questions.a: Level 3: detailed place knowledge, balanced, substantiated judgement
questions.model: Teacher talks through the plan for 2 minutes before timing.

questions.q: Self-assess with the level descriptors and write one target.
questions.a: Accurate self-assessment with a specific target

questions.q: Suggest a more sustainable plan for Holderness.
questions.a: Mix of managed retreat where land value is low, compensation for residents, protecting key settlements

questions.q: Explain one negative effect of the Mappleton scheme.
questions.a: Groynes trapped sediment (1), so the coast to the south received less and eroded faster (1)
questions.model: Cause: sand trapped. Effect downdrift: less sand. Result: faster erosion.
